summary: Universal /link/<code> short-link system is complete and matches the task: no-migrate table (ensure + model + sql), base62 service, auto-create on single+bulk create, admin API, public resolver, crawler-OG-reusing + human smart-redirect route, all-UA Apache rule, and bilingual product Share button. api-node tsc build, prisma validate, and web build all pass.

findings.detail: createCustomShortLink stores any http(s) target with no origin allowlist, so an admin-created /link/<code> can redirect to an arbitrary external site (open-redirect off the 4astore.com/link/* namespace). It is gated behind requireStaff('ads') so the blast radius is trusted staff only, and satisfies the explicit 'any url' requirement. Confirm this is intended; otherwise constrain targets to SITE_ORIGIN or a configured allowlist.

When a code has no product/page/category OG card (e.g. a custom-type link), a crawler UA falls through to the human smart-redirect HTML instead of an OG card, so custom links produce no rich unfurl. Product links (the primary case) always get the OG card. Acceptable as designed; noted because the admin UI invites arbitrary URLs.

The Android app-open fallback (1200ms setTimeout -> Play Store, cancelled on pagehide/visibilitychange) is inherently browser-dependent and can occasionally send an app-having user to the Play Store or the reverse on slow devices. This is intrinsic to the intent:// technique, not a code defect. Verify on real Android devices/browsers post-deploy, as the FEAT findings already mark the curl/device checks.

The ShortLink Prisma delegate exists only in this worktree's regenerated client (node_modules not committed). The merge/deploy target must run `prisma generate` or `tsc` will fail there (no prisma.shortLink). deploy.sh runs prisma generate on deploy, but a local main checkout will fail to build until it regenerates. No code change needed; informational for whoever merges.
